test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The government will distribute additional land allotment certificates to the landless families.

options.text: The landless families will distribute additional land allotment certificates to the government.
The government will be distributing additional land allotment certificates to the landless families.
The government will be distributed additional land allotment certificates to the landless families.
Additional land allotment certificates will be distributed to the landless families by the government.

solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'Additional land allotment certificates will be distributed to the landless families by the government.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in the future indefinite tense form. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + will + V1 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + will + be + V3 + by + Subject
 
 
 
• Let’s see an example:
 
 
• Active voice: Rohit will drive the car to the airport.
 
• Passive voice: *The car will be driven to the airport by Rohit.*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The government' and the object of the given sentence is 'additional land allotment certificates.'
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• Also here, 'will distribute' will be changed into 'will be distributed.'
 
• Add 'by' before the subject.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Additional land allotment certificates will be distributed to the landless families by the government.*
